purpose: Temporary pnpm overrides that fix osv-scanner findings whose dependency paths cannot be fixed by an in-range upgrade (Phase 1 Step 9). Each entry pins an exact version, names the advisories it fixes and records why the upstream chain cannot fix it yet. scripts/policy/integrity.mjs requires that this register and pnpm-workspace.yaml agree. These are security fixes, not dependency upgrades: when upstream ships a fix, remove the override and take the upstream version.
rules: Exact versions only; ranges are rejected.
Every override must satisfy the 14-day minimumReleaseAge policy like any other package.
Every override must be re-verified by TOOL-1 (both apps) and the full test suite before it is committed.
reviewedOn is the date the override was validated and implemented; nextReviewDate is when it must be re-checked. Remove the override once the upstream chain carries a fixed version.

overrides.path: orval@8.27.0 -> js-yaml (contracts code generation, development tooling)
overrides.reason: orval 8.27.0 pins js-yaml exactly 4.3.1, so no in-range upgrade can reach the patched 4.3.2.
overrides.upstream: orval 8.31.0+ pins js-yaml 4.3.2 but was published 2026-09-10 and is not yet 14 days old; take it once it is eligible.

overrides.reason: ipx 3.1.1 declares sharp ^0.34.3, so the patched 0.35.4 is outside the declared range. The Netlify image path does not execute during a netlify build (only /_ipx/* redirect rules are emitted); Next.js already resolves sharp 0.35.4.
overrides.upstream: No stable fix exists: every @netlify/dev through 5.1.2 pins @netlify/images 2.0.1 -> ipx ^3.1.1, and ipx 4.x (sharp ^0.35.x) is alpha/beta only.

overrides.reason: Both declare toml ^3.0.0, so the patched 4.2.0+ is outside the declared range.
overrides.upstream: Upgrading netlify-cli is not sufficient: 27.5.1 still carries toml 3.0.0 via @netlify/dev@5.0.5 -> @netlify/functions-dev@2.0.5 -> zip-it-and-ship-it@15.4.2, and newer CLI releases are not yet 14 days old. Re-check when @netlify/dev 5.1.x becomes eligible.
